story: In June, Ben and Anna work in the garden. They see twelve pink flowers near the bath. Ben wants to eat each banana piece. He will turn around for a moment. He eats until it is nine. Anna eats another piece of fruit.
title: A Day in the Garden
setting: A sunny garden with flowers and a small outdoor bath.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: A young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: A young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow dress.

sentences.en: It is a sunny day in June.
sentences.zh: 现在是阳光明媚的六月。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and Anna stand in a sunny garden under a bright sun.

sentences.en: Ben and Anna work in the garden.
sentences.zh: 本和安娜在花园里工作。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and Anna are planting small green plants in the garden.

sentences.en: Anna sees twelve beautiful pink flowers.
sentences.zh: 安娜看到了十二朵美丽的粉红色的花。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna looks at twelve bright pink flowers in the garden.

sentences.en: The flowers are near the small bath.
sentences.scene_prompt: Twelve pink flowers grow next to a small outdoor bath.

sentences.en: Ben wants to eat each banana piece.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben holds several small pieces of a yellow banana.

sentences.en: He will turn around for a moment.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben turns his body around in the garden.

sentences.en: He eats until it is nine.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben eats a banana near a clock showing nine.

sentences.en: Anna eats another piece of fruit.
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna eats a small piece of fruit from a bowl.
